title: Confirms, with the check-in code
does: The customer is booked, with a check-in code that's new for this visit. Only they get the code, and give it to Riley at the chair. That shows Riley really came.
more: The AI gets a booking number, but not the code.
No street address, card or private detail ever passes through the AI.
The code line follows the plug-in's visit kind: at the chair, at a drop-off, or at the start of a video call.
The card shows the way in, from Sam's access details, or a video session's link or who calls whom.
Any notice said at booking is on it too, and any prep that starts before the next reminder would reach them.
Booked after the free-cancel time: it says 'No free cancel'. Booked after the reminder hour: it carries the reminder.
A customer in another time zone sees each deadline in their time too.
On a call, the read-back on the call was the confirmation, with the code said twice.
Where the service meets away: the meeting point and where it ends, in place of the address.
Where Sam set a plain display name, texts, pay pages and the card statement show it.
Must carry: the business, the service, the date and time, the person, and the address and way in.
Must carry too: the price and how it's paid, anything saved or paid, and the free-cancel time and fee.
And the code and where to give it, and how to change or cancel.
